landing.heroEyebrow: A collaboration space that preserves the trail of real work
landing.heroTitle: Contribute to real work. Build a record that can be verified.
landing.heroDescription: Sharek organizes collaboration between project owners and contributors — from discovering the right work to completing and reviewing it. The result is not a count of applications or badges, but a documented contribution that explains what was done, who reviewed it, and what the evidence is.
landing.heroStoryDescription: It starts with understanding the contributor's fit and the requirements, then the project owner's decision, delivering the work, and reviewing the evidence — ending in a verified contribution record. The automated analysis advises; the decision and review stay with humans.
landing.heroPrincipleCompletedContribution: Progress is measured by a completed contribution
landing.heroPrincipleHumanDecision: The final decision stays with humans
landing.heroPrincipleEvidence: Every important claim traces back to evidence
landing.heroFallbackTitle: Improving keyboard navigation in the Arabic interface
landing.heroFallbackOwnerDecision: Owner decision: accepted by a human decision
landing.heroFallbackEvidence: Evidence: pull request + work description + owner review
landing.journeyHeading: The journey starts with the right work and ends with a lasting professional impact.
landing.journeyDescription: Every step is designed to serve the contribution itself. No popularity contests, no application races, and no activity measured just to keep people on the platform.
landing.journeyStep1Title: Discover suitable work and understand what's required
landing.journeyStep1Description: Learn about the project, the task scope, the way of collaborating, and the evidence required. The assisted evaluation shows what supports the fit and what is missing, without blocking you from applying.
landing.journeyStep2Title: Submit your application and receive the owner's decision
landing.journeyStep2Description: A clear application reaches the project owner with the right context. Automated analysis explains the signals and uncertainty; the project owner makes the final selection decision.
landing.journeyStep3Title: Collaborate and complete the agreed work
landing.journeyStep3Description: After acceptance, the contribution's collaboration space begins: a specific task, a related discussion, clear statuses, and a deliverable that can be reviewed.
landing.journeyStep4Title: Submit the evidence and build a trustworthy record
landing.journeyStep4Description: The result, its sources, and its visibility are reviewed. A completed contribution becomes a professional record that preserves context without exposing private source information.
landing.evidenceHeading: Evidence is not a badge. It is a record that can be understood and reviewed.
landing.evidenceDescription: Sharek doesn't ask people to trust a professional claim without context. Every contribution record explains the source, the verification method, visibility, freshness, and review status.
landing.evidenceSampleTitle: Improving keyboard navigation in the Arabic interface
landing.evidenceSampleDescription: Clear context for the work, the outcome reviewed by the project, and the evidence justifying its place in the professional record.
landing.evidenceSourceDescription: A pull request, owner statement, attachment, description, screenshot, or demo link.
landing.evidenceMethodDescription: Who reviewed the evidence, what they confirmed, and what remained undecided.
landing.evidenceVisibilityDescription: What can be published, what stays private, and who can see it.
landing.evidenceFreshnessDescription: When the evidence was collected, and whether it awaits review or has been confirmed or disputed.
landing.evidenceAiAdvisoryDescription: Sharek explains the supporting and missing signals, and the level of confidence and uncertainty. It doesn't turn the outcome into a final verdict, and it can't block an application on its own.
landing.evidenceSupportingEvidenceText: Shown in text, not through a vague color or score.
landing.evidenceVisibilityLimitText: The explanation doesn't reveal a private file, name, or excerpt that isn't allowed.
landing.evidenceHumanPathText: The owner makes the choice, and the user can review or object.
landing.evidenceNotOnlyGithubDescription: It can come from an authorized repository, an owner statement, an attachment, a description, a screenshot, a demo link, or non-repository work when the contract supports it.
landing.workspaceHeading: After acceptance, the agreement becomes a single workspace.
landing.workspaceDescription: Every accepted contribution gets its own space: the task, the discussion, and the deliverable in one place tied together by a single audit thread. What happens there doesn't evaporate when finished — it becomes part of the contribution's evidence.
landing.workspaceTaskTerm: One task with a clear scope
landing.workspaceTaskDescription: What is required, how it will be reviewed, and what evidence is expected at delivery — announced before the work starts, not after.
landing.workspaceDiscussionTerm: A discussion that keeps its context
landing.workspaceDiscussionDescription: Questions and decisions stay attached to the task itself, so they don't get lost in scattered tools or re-told from memory.
landing.workspaceExplicitStatesDescription: In progress, ready for review, accepted — every transition is announced, and both parties see the same state at the same moment.
landing.rolesContributorTitle: Make the work you've done understandable and trustworthy.
landing.rolesContributorDescription: Sharek helps you reach a meaningful contribution, complete it clearly, and then keep a record that relies on neither self-claims nor popularity.
landing.rolesContributorPoint1: Discover work that fits your current context, with missing evidence and uncertainty made clear.
landing.rolesContributorPoint2: Collaborate inside the project space after acceptance — not in an application race or a global leaderboard.
landing.rolesContributorPoint3: Turn completed, reviewed work into a professional record that preserves its context and source.
landing.rolesOwnerTitle: Find a fitting contributor with less ambiguity, not more applications.
landing.rolesOwnerDescription: Present work as clear collaboration context, understand what supports each applicant's fit, then make the decision and review the outcome yourself.
landing.rolesOwnerPoint1: State the scope of work, requirements, and review method before anyone applies.
landing.rolesOwnerPoint2: Use assisted analysis to reduce ambiguity while keeping the final selection decision.
landing.rolesOwnerPoint3: Review the outcome and create fair evidence with a clear audit trail when needed.
landing.recordHeading: The contribution ends, and the record remains — and accumulates.
landing.recordDescription: What you accomplish through Sharek doesn't turn into a number on a counter, but into a line in a professional record that answers the questions that actually matter: what was done, who reviewed it, and what the evidence is.
landing.recordAccumulatesDescription: Every completed contribution adds a new line to the record. It doesn't start from zero with each project, and it isn't erased when you leave.
landing.recordHonestDescription: What has been verified shows as verified, and what is still under review shows as such — waiting for review never becomes a confirmed claim.
landing.recordSharedLimitsDescription: You decide what is shown publicly and what stays private. What is published carries its context and evidence, not a title with no attribution.
landing.ctaHeading: Make your next contribution meaningful work and a record worth trusting.
landing.ctaDescription: Create your account as a contributor or a project owner. Important decisions will stay with humans, and the evidence will stay understandable and reviewable.
landing.storyPlayerDescription: A silent illustrative scene showing a contribution journey — from understanding fit and requirements, through the project owner's decision, delivery, and evidence review, to a verified contribution record. Automated analysis organizes signals and explains gaps, while the decision and review remain human.
landing.storyHeaderSubtitle: Illustrative example · a real person, specific work, and reviewable evidence
landing.storyContributionTitle: Improving keyboard navigation in the Arabic interface
landing.storyContributorsLine: Contribution: Mariam A. · Reviewer: project team
landing.storyAiRoleDescription: It arranged the signals and explained the gaps. The project owner made the decision, and the human review confirmed the outcome.
landing.storyPhase1Detail: Partial fit · evidence and gaps are clear
landing.storyPhase3Detail: Pull request + work description + test screenshots
landing.storyPhase4Detail: The owner verified the outcome and the source
